name: Nekajui, A Ritz Carlton Reserve
positioning: Ritz-Carlton Reserve (official name Nekajui Peninsula Papagayo, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve) on a private 1,400-acre peninsula on Costa Rica's Pacific coast
best_for: Travelers who want a nature-focused Pacific coast stay with guided outdoor adventures
Families who want a children's program and outdoor activities on site

facts.text: Nekajui sits in Peninsula Papagayo, a 1,400-acre private peninsula on Costa Rica's Pacific coast.
Accommodations face views of Playa Pochote and the Pacific Ocean.
The name Nekajui comes from the Chorotega word for lush garden.
Accommodations include glamping tents with private plunge pools and residences of two to five bedrooms.
Suite and tent stays include a complimentary minibar with a full honor bar, including alcoholic beverages.
Puna serves Peruvian-influenced fine dining under Chef Diego Muñoz.
Niri Beach Club offers oceanfront dining with Iberian flavors and grill-forward dishes.
The spa has hydrotherapy pools, a movement studio and ocean-facing treatment villas.
Camp Nekajui is a children's program for ages 4 to 12.
Surf lessons are offered through SurfX.

highlights.text: Papagayo Explorers runs guided hikes, ziplining and wildlife tours at The Outpost in the 250-acre Palmares Preserve.
There are three tents at the lowest elevation of the accommodations, just above the beach.
Café Rincón celebrates Costa Rica's coffee and cacao heritage with roasted-to-order brews and artisan chocolates.
Each stay has a dedicated Manzu who arranges personalized services and experiences.

considerations.text: The daily resort fee covers Wi-Fi, priority reservations, wellness programming, beach club privileges and access to Papagayo Park.
WhataHotel notes the remote Peninsula Papagayo location requires planned transportation.
A funicular lets guests reach Niri Beach Club, though stairs beyond it make the beach less accessible.
